deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O4 Name & photo': a back chevron and a six-segment step-progress bar (four filled) sit above the title; the app has neither
deviations.reason: [shared] onboarding step header (none exists): a back chevron and a six-segment step-progress bar drawn on every sign-up step frame; the app has no such component
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (the frame decides components and placement); 13 §3.2 rows S0.3/S0.4

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O4 Name & photo: the photo picker is an 84 px dashed-outline circle with a camera glyph and the word 'Photo', placed to the LEFT of the name field on one row; the app draws an 80 px filled beige circle with an add-photo icon, centred ABOVE the field, with 'Add a photo (optional)' under it
deviations.reason: [screen] DESIGN-PACK O4 asks only for 'optional circular photo picker'; the frame decides its placement and form

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O4 Name & photo: the explanation sits BELOW the field in two muted lines — 'Your family sees this when they approve your entries.' and 'The photo is optional and stays on the phones of people who share a book with you.'; the app puts one subtitle under the title in full ink — 'Shown in approvals and the verification ceremony — not shared beyond your books'
deviations.reason: [screen] DESIGN-PACK O4 rules the muted line 'Your family sees this when they approve your entries.'; the app's copy and placement differ

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O4 Name & photo: the field's label 'Your name' is small and muted and the typed name is large (~20 px); in the app the label is navy (focused primary) and the value is body size (16 px); the empty field shows a hint 'e.g. Sunita Kaur' the frame does not draw (the frame shows only the filled state)
deviations.reason: [shared] text field (InputDecoration theme): label colour and value size come from the shared theme

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O4 Name & photo (filled): the caret sits after 'Amrit Kaur'; in the app's filled capture the caret is drawn over the last letter
deviations.reason: [shared] text field — observed, not diagnosed; likely the theme's inherited letterSpacing (see the tracking deviation)

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O4 Name & photo: draws only the filled state with Continue awake; the app's empty state adds 'Enter your name to continue' above a disabled (grey-filled) Continue — a state the frame does not draw
deviations.reason: [screen] 07 §1 rule 6 (no dead ends): a disabled button says why. The disabled fill is the shared primary button's disabled style, which c1 O3 draws as an outlined pale button instead
deviations.authority: 07 §1 rule 6 🔒; c1/O3 Purpose picker (disabled Continue pattern)

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O4 Name & photo: Continue is square-cornered ~52 px within a ~20 px gutter; app ~48 px rounded inside 24 px
deviations.reason: [shared] primary button (FilledButton theme, app/lib/shared/theme.dart): ~48 px tall with RkRadius corners, inset by the ~24 px screen padding
deviations.authority: design/tokens/tokens.json radius + the canvas's button component; ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (the frame decides components)

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O4 Name & photo: content inset is ~21 px from the screen edge; the app's is 24 px (tokens.json space.gutter is 16)
